mentions.name: OpenSpend
mentions.description: OpenSpend is an open-source, free-to-use, self-hosted payment gateway that lets end users send money directly to businesses via their online banking app or website. Businesses can check live and instantly whether money has been deposited.
mentions.audience: Developers integrating payments into apps and businesses accepting payments
mentions.source_excerpt: OpenSpend is an open-source, free-to-use, self-hosted payment gateway for your next app, project, or business. It lets end users send money directly to businesses using their online banking app or website. And businesses can check live and instantly whether the money has been deposited or not.
